Participants discussed upcoming roadmap items, integration with other data lake tools, and shared community feedback on feature requests. The discussion highlights an alternative using the SnapshotAncestryValidator hook introduced in 1.11 for conflict detection, and explains the use case of embedding a proprietary index into a statistics file.
